_about: PC runner settings (B4100-B4109). train: this runner drives the merge train (B7202; only the Main PC's); trainMinutes, trainMaxHours and sweepUpdates are optional. lanes: the testbed lanes the runner drives, never 1, and not 6 (kept for the local agents since 2026-11-16, B6527). light: jobs that need no lane (book and Trove lookups) run side by side up to this many.
